method: Direct Amazon result-page inspection plus current primary sources for regulated finalists. Search-result counts and visible ratings are snapshots, not unit-sales data.

sources.evidence: 78 results. First page contained at least five books dated Aug 24-Sep 3 2026 with no visible ratings. Older manuals showed 33, 46 and 54 ratings. Visible paperback prices were mostly about EUR7.73-EUR17.20 when delivered to France.
61 results. Most visible books were EUR5.99-EUR12.16 and had zero to nine ratings; many near-duplicate journals were present. This weakens the earlier RN3 price-power thesis.
12 broad sustainability-reporting results, but no clearly exact VSME workbook. A 2024 practical reporting title showed 12 ratings; a June 2026 CSRD/ESRS title had no visible rating.
On July 3, 2026 the Commission adopted revised ESRS and a voluntary reporting standard for smaller companies, making pre-July VSME packaging unusually volatile.
The July 30, 2025 recommendation framed VSME as a way for SMEs to answer sustainability requests from large companies and financial institutions.
EFRAG provides free standards, educational videos and digital-template support, increasing free-alternative pressure.
A 2023 professional eulogy writer marketed a 169-page A4 workbook at GBP9.99 with sixteen worksheets. This demonstrates a concrete incumbent architecture, not current sales traction.

limitations: Amazon did not expose BSR on inspected search pages; no BSR was inferred.
Ratings and result counts can change and do not prove sales.
Most broad candidates deliberately received only cheap screening evidence.
No candidate was authorized on inference alone.
